<quote by="Proposed: Merari Navigators of Virtue, Senator for the Bastion, Seconded: Pathfinder Gaddak, Senator for Mareave">To commission the Archives of the Advisor, to be built in Solvihill, Skarsind. This sinecure will produce 12 iridescent gloaming a season. This sinecure will be attached to the already existing title of Advisor on Orc Affairs
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Solvihill, Skarsind and amends the title of [[Advisor on Orc Affairs]]
* Passed

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 wains of white granite
* 30 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Archives_of_the_Advisor}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Advisor on Orc Affairs]] will receive 12 measures of [[iridescent gloaming]] each season starting at the Winter Solstice 388YE
